title: calcLpTokenSupply returns a number when it has not converged
rootCause: Stable2.calcLpTokenSupply ends its 255 steps without a revert when the iteration has not settled, so a caller gets the last guess as the supply, where calcReserve in the same contract reverts on that condition.

poc.observable: test_a_supply_that_comes_back_has_converged fails with "how far the supply it returned moves on one more step: 341995 > 1"
